reviews.name: Dyon Lee
reviews.text: My first time engaging the service from Scrubbys, and I am totally amazed by the service. Moving in to apartment and wanted to have a thorough clean of the house, and came back few hours to a very bright shining clean house. Perfectionist, even to the last minute, they were still looking for tiny dirts that I could not even spot myself while concluding the checks. Salutes to the team for excellent service. Please consider them in any of your cleaning requirements

reviews.name: Joanne Chua
reviews.text: Scrubbys staff were amazingly thorough! They cleaned the entire 3 bedroom condo from top to bottom and even took apart the oven to clean all the crevices. They steamed the floors and curtains as well. No corner was left untouched. Communication was smooth and a pleasant experience. Would recommend!

reviews.name: Anita Loh
reviews.text:
I would like to say a big thank you to Jun Wei and the Scrubbys team for helping with my post-renovation cleaning. Despite my busy schedule, they were very accommodating and made the whole process smooth and fuss-free.

The team did a thorough job cleaning up the house after renovation, and I really appreciate their effort in making the place feel much cleaner and more comfortable. Jun Wei was also very helpful and patient in sharing useful cleaning tips with me, which I found very practical.

Overall, I’m very happy with the service provided by Jun Wei and his team. Thank you once again for the hard work, professionalism, and excellent service. I would definitely recommend Scrubbys to anyone looking for post-renovation cleaning services.

reviews.name: Tan Eehan
reviews.text:
Got to know Scrubby from one of Overkill’s video. Decided to try out their service for move in cleaning.

The team deployed 4 helpers and cleaned the 4 room hdb for close to 5 hours. Cleaning quality was excellent and thorough! All the stubborn stains came off after their cleaning. The helpers pay close attention to hidden corners and grills. One of the key differentiator was the engagement manager who was onsite to walk through the cleaning areas and focus ateas to align expectations. He was also there to do debrief after the cleaning was done. Such customer service is greatly appreciated and welcomed.

Highly recommended!!!
